spec.text: An old hand-drawn treasure map on aged, stained parchment, seen flat from above, filling the frame. Ink coastline of a volcanic island, a winding dotted route, a compass rose in one corner, small sea-monster and sailing-ship illustrations, faint latitude lines, a red X near a cove. Burnt edges, wax stain, fold creases. Warm candle-lit tone. Do not write any real words; use illegible scribbles for place names.
